_readme.about: Maintenance schedules used to pre-fill intervals when a vehicle is added. JSON has no comments, so this block documents the format; it is ignored by the integration.
_readme.your_own_cars: Don't edit this file (updates overwrite it). Create /config/vehicle_service/vehicles.json with the same structure. Your entries are checked first, and any 'generic' items you list replace the defaults below. Restart isn't needed; the file is read each time you add a vehicle.
_readme.service_ids: oil, tire_rotation, inspection, wipers, air_filter, cabin_filter, brake_fluid, coolant, transmission, spark_plugs, differential, fuel_filter, battery, registration, state_inspection

interval_fields.miles: Recurring interval in miles. Omit or 0 = not tracked by mileage.
interval_fields.months: Recurring interval in months. Omit or 0 = not tracked by time. If both are set, whichever comes first wins.
interval_fields.first_miles: Optional. First interval when it differs from later ones (e.g. coolant first at 100,000, then every 50,000). Used until the item is logged once.
interval_fields.first_months: Optional. Same as first_miles, for time.
interval_fields.action: Optional. 'replace' (default) or 'inspect'. Shown as an attribute so a dashboard can treat inspections differently.
interval_fields.note: Optional. Free text shown as an attribute, e.g. fluid type or conditions.

_readme.generic: Fallback intervals for every service item. Used for any vehicle without a library match, and for any item a vehicle's schedule doesn't list.

makes.<make key>: Lowercase, letters and numbers only (e.g. 'subaru', 'landrover'). Matched against the VIN decoder's make the same way.
makes.name: Display name, e.g. 'Subaru'.

schedules.id: Required, unique and never changed once used, e.g. 'toyota-rav4-2017-2.5-gas'. Saved with each vehicle.
schedules.engines: Optional list of displacements in liters as strings, e.g. ['2.5']. Omit to match any.
schedules.transmissions: Optional list: 'automatic', 'cvt', 'manual'. Omit to match any.
schedules.fuel: Optional list: 'gasoline', 'diesel', 'hybrid', 'plug_in_hybrid', 'electric'. Omit to match any.
schedules.label: Optional text shown when picking a schedule, e.g. '2.5i CVT'.
schedules.verified: true once checked against the manufacturer's booklet for this model year.
schedules.intervals: { service_id: interval } for the normal schedule.
schedules.severe: Optional { service_id: interval } overrides for the severe / special-conditions schedule. Offered as a toggle during setup.
